summary: Replaced two-element fttl/fttl2 text approach with a single ftxt text element using tspan children for multi-line rendering. Enter: one append('text.ftxt') with fill/font-weight/font-size. Update: .each() builds tspan per nodeLines() entry with dy spacing via NH_EXTRA. Eliminates the fttl2 opacity-toggle hack.

subject: Fix graph node label overflow — multi-line tspan rendering
description:
Node labels that wrap to 3+ lines overflow the card bottom. The current approach uses two fixed SVG text elements (fttl + fttl2) where fttl2 just joins all remaining lines into one string — no actual wrapping.

Fix in public/graph.html around lines 4919-4931:

1. Replace the two `en.append('text')` lines for fttl/fttl2 with ONE text element:
   OLD:
   ```
   en.append('text').attr('class','fttl').attr('x',-NW/2+12);
   en.append('text').attr('class','fttl2').attr('x',-NW/2+12);
   ```
   NEW:
   ```
   en.append('text').attr('class','ftxt').attr('fill','#e6edf3').attr('font-weight',600).attr('font-size',13);
   ```

2. Replace the two `na.select('.fttl')` and `na.select('.fttl2')` update lines with:
   OLD (lines 4930-4931):
   ```
   na.select('.fttl').attr('fill','#e6edf3').attr('font-weight',600).attr('y',t=>nodeLines(t).length>1?-nodeH(t)/2+18:-2).text(t=>nodeLines(t)[0]);
   na.select('.fttl2').attr('fill','#e6edf3').attr('font-weight',600).attr('font-size',13).attr('y',t=>nodeLines(t).length>1?-nodeH(t)/2+34:0).attr('opacity',t=>nodeLines(t).length>1?1:0).text(t=>{ const ls=nodeLines(t); return ls.length>1?ls.slice(1).join(' '):''; });
   ```
   NEW:
   ```
   na.select('.ftxt').attr('y',t=>-nodeH(t)/2+18).each(function(t){ const ls=nodeLines(t); d3.select(this).selectAll('tspan').data(ls).join('tspan').attr('x',-NW/2+12).attr('dy',(d,i)=>i===0?0:NH_EXTRA+'px').text(d=>d); });
   ```

No other changes. The fst (status text) positioning on line 4934 is already correct and does not need updating.
